en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate Neo-Renaissance building on a broad, empty street. The structure has rusticated stone on the lower floors, tall rectangular windows with classical pediments, statues along the roofline, and elaborate cornices. A wrought-iron fence and low stone posts separate the building's garden from the street. The scene is quiet, with no visible vehicles and only a few small figures near the entrance. There is no printed caption or visible writing on the front.
